snippet.title: Cozy Builder | Demo Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
The Cozy Builder demo is now live on Steam 🌿
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4059000/Cozy_Builder/ 

Build, design, and decorate your dream château in a cozy vineyard valley. Live among your creations, harvest grapes from sunlit vineyards, and craft artisanal wine blends in a relaxing sandbox builder where every home helps restore beauty and balance to the countryside.

#cozygames #cozygaming #indiegames
